entries.instruction: Consolidate the 4 separate loops in the uniquePathsWithObstacles method into a single pass. The current approach iterates over the same data structure multiple times. Merge the loop bodies to eliminate duplicate iteration and improve performance.

llm_calls.raw_response: public class Solution { public int uniquePathsWithObstacles(int[][] grid) { int m = grid.length; int n = grid[0].length; if (grid[0][0] == 1 || grid[m - 1][n - 1] == 1) return 0; for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) { if (grid[i][j] == 1) continue; if (i > 0 && grid[i - 1][j] != 0 || j > 0 && grid[i][j - 1] != 0) grid[i][j] = (i > 0 ? grid[i - 1][j] : 0) + (j > 0 ? grid[i][j - 1] : 0); else grid[i][j] = i == j && i == 0 ? 1 : 0; } return grid[m - 1][n - 1]; } }
